test_run_combined_tests: run combined performance, accuracy, and tool call tests for a list of model configurations
test_run_performance_test: run performance tests with configurable batch sizes, input lengths, and output lengths
test_run_accuracy_test: run accuracy tests against a specified dataset and baseline accuracy threshold
test_run_tool_call_test: run tool call tests and report pass count against total test cases
test_write_accuracy_github_summary: write accuracy test results to GitHub summary for CI reporting
